            _platform_config_key,
        )
        from agent.secret_scope import get_secret
        from gateway.display_config import resolve_display_setting, resolve_tool_progress
        from gateway.status_phrases import choose_status_phrase, resolve_status_phrase_catalog
        user_config = _load_gateway_config()
        platform_key = _platform_config_key(source.platform)
        enabled_toolsets, disabled_toolsets = self._resolve_turn_toolsets(user_config, source, platform_key)
        adapter = self._delivery_adapter_for(source)
        # Tool preview length (0 = no limit) and friendly tool labels (default on), per-platform.
        for _setter, _setting, _default, _cast in (
            ("set_tool_preview_max_len", "tool_preview_length", 0, lambda v: int(v) if v else 0),
            ("set_friendly_tool_labels", "friendly_tool_labels", True, bool),
        ):
            with suppress(Exception):
                from agent import display as _agent_display
                _val = resolve_display_setting(user_config, platform_key, _setting, _default)
                getattr(_agent_display, _setter)(_cast(_val))

        # Resolve the mode and its provenance together: null inherits, tier off is not intent.
        # A raw os.getenv here reads whichever profile's env loaded last under multiplexing
        # (#116898); get_secret resolves through the active profile's scope instead.
        progress_mode, _tool_progress_explicit = resolve_tool_progress(
            user_config, platform_key, get_secret("HERMES_TOOL_PROGRESS_MODE"),
        )
        # "accumulate" (edit one bubble) or "separate" (one msg per tool)
        progress_grouping = resolve_display_setting(user_config, platform_key, "tool_progress_grouping") or "accumulate"
        _generic_status_recent: List[str] = []
        _generic_status_catalog = resolve_status_phrase_catalog(user_config, platform_key)

        def _display_surface_mode(
            setting: str, *, default: bool = False,
            require_platform_override_for: set[Any] | None = None, allow_generic: bool = False,
        ) -> str:
            """Return off|raw|generic for a gateway visibility surface."""
            if require_platform_override_for:
                current_platform = _gateway_platform_value(source.platform)
                platform_only = {_gateway_platform_value(item) for item in require_platform_override_for}
                if (
                    current_platform in platform_only
                    and not _has_platform_display_override(user_config, platform_key, setting)
                ):
                    return "off"
            value = resolve_display_setting(user_config, platform_key, setting, default)
            if isinstance(value, str) and value.strip().lower() == "generic":
                return "generic" if allow_generic else "off"
            return "raw" if bool(value) else "off"

        def _generic_status_phrase(kind: str, *, tool_name: str | None = None, preview: str | None = None, args: Any = None) -> str:
            try:
                return choose_status_phrase(
                    kind, tool_name=tool_name, preview=preview, args=args,
                    recent=_generic_status_recent, catalog=_generic_status_catalog,
                )
            except Exception as _phrase_err:
                logger.debug("generic status phrase selection failed: %s", _phrase_err)
                return "still on it" if kind in {"heartbeat", "waiting", "long_running", "status"} else "one sec"

        # Webhooks can't edit messages, so tool progress / log mode are off there.
        is_webhook = source.platform == Platform.WEBHOOK
        tool_progress_enabled = progress_mode not in {"off", "log"} and not is_webhook
        # Live status for text-rendering typing indicators (Slack); independent of tool_progress.
        _live_status_mode = resolve_display_setting(user_config, platform_key, "live_status", "full")
        _live_status_adapter = (
            adapter if getattr(adapter, "supports_status_text", False) and _live_status_mode != "off" else None
        )
        # "log" mode: tool calls go to ~/.hermes/logs/tool_calls.log instead of the chat. Gateway-only.
        log_mode_enabled = progress_mode == "log" and not is_webhook
        # Interim assistant messages and thinking_progress are independent of tool progress (same
        # queue). Mattermost requires a per-platform opt-in: scratch text leaks into public threads.
        interim_assistant_messages_mode = _display_surface_mode(
            "interim_assistant_messages", default=True, require_platform_override_for={Platform.MATTERMOST},
        )
        interim_assistant_messages_enabled = not is_webhook and interim_assistant_messages_mode != "off"
        _thinking_enabled = _display_surface_mode(
            "thinking_progress", default=False, require_platform_override_for={Platform.MATTERMOST},
        ) != "off"
        # Slack-native task cards need the progress queue even with text tool_progress off.
        # Slack-native task cards (#29483): when the Slack adapter's opt-in is set, tool progress renders as
        # native plan/task cards via chat.startStream — the progress queue is needed even though Slack keeps
        # ordinary text tool_progress off by default (requiring both flags would silently leave the native
        # feature inactive).
        # Cards are still tool progress. Slack's TIER default (``off``) only quiets the text lane so
        # cards stay on for unconfigured installs, but an operator who WRITES ``tool_progress: off``
        # (global, platform override, or legacy overrides) has asked for no tool progress at all and
        # gets no cards either. Every other explicit mode keeps the card lane.
        _native_slack_task_cards = False
        if (
            source.platform == Platform.SLACK
            and hasattr(adapter, "native_task_cards_enabled")
            and not (_tool_progress_explicit and progress_mode == "off")
        ):
            try:
                _native_slack_task_cards = bool(adapter.native_task_cards_enabled())
            except Exception:
                logger.debug("Slack native task-card config check failed", exc_info=True)
        return self._RunAgentDisplay(
            user_config=user_config, platform_key=platform_key, enabled_toolsets=enabled_toolsets,
            disabled_toolsets=disabled_toolsets, resolve_display_setting=resolve_display_setting,
            progress_mode=progress_mode, progress_grouping=progress_grouping,
            _display_surface_mode=_display_surface_mode,
            tool_progress_enabled=tool_progress_enabled, _live_status_mode=_live_status_mode,
            _live_status_adapter=_live_status_adapter, log_mode_enabled=log_mode_enabled,
            log_queue=queue.Queue() if log_mode_enabled else None,
            interim_assistant_messages_enabled=interim_assistant_messages_enabled,
            _thinking_enabled=_thinking_enabled, _native_slack_task_cards=_native_slack_task_cards,
            needs_progress_queue=tool_progress_enabled or _thinking_enabled or _native_slack_task_cards,
            _generic_status_phrase=_generic_status_phrase,
        )

        self, event: MessageEvent, session_key: str, text_content: str, metadata: Dict[str, Any], *,
        reply_to: Optional[str], is_ephemeral_response: bool = False,
    ) -> "tuple[SendResult, BasePlatformAdapter]":
        """The delivery-ledger bracket every final text goes through, on the CURRENT transport
        (a reconnect may have replaced this adapter): record the obligation before the send,
        send with retry, finalize from the result — so a refused final (flood control, a dead
        transport) leaves a ledger row the boot sweep / runtime redelivery can act on. ``event``
        supplies the source and the ledger identity (``ledger_message_id`` or ``message_id``).
        Returns the result with the adapter that sent it: that adapter owns ``result.message_id``
        (an ephemeral delete must go to the same transport)."""
        delivery_adapter = self._final_delivery_adapter(event.source)
        logger.info("[%s] Sending response (%d chars) to %s", delivery_adapter.name,
                    len(text_content), event.source.chat_id)
        obligation_id = await self._record_delivery_obligation(
            event, session_key, text_content, delivery_adapter, is_ephemeral_response)
        if obligation_id is not None:
            await self._release_turn_marker(event)  # the ledger now owns the crash recovery
        result = await delivery_adapter._send_with_retry(
            chat_id=event.source.chat_id, content=text_content, reply_to=reply_to, metadata=metadata)
        if obligation_id is not None:
            await self._finalize_delivery_obligation(obligation_id, result, event, delivery_adapter)
        return result, delivery_adapter

"""Trusted context policy construction, environment and port allocation."""
import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import socket
import subprocess
import urllib.request


HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def atomic_json(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    temporary = path.with_suffix(".tmp")
    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + "\n")
    temporary.chmod(0o600)
    os.replace(temporary, path)


class Context:
    def __init__(self, home):
        self.home = Path(home).resolve(strict=True)
        self.manifest = self.home / ".clanker-execution" / "context.json"
        self.config = json.loads(self.manifest.read_text())
        if self.config["home"] != str(self.home) or not self.config.get("enabled"):
            raise RuntimeError("No execution grant for this context")
        self.fleet = Path(self.config["fleet"])
        self.settings = json.loads((self.fleet / "fleet.json").read_text())
        if hashlib.sha256((HERE / "common.sb").read_bytes()).hexdigest() != self.settings["policy_sha256"]:
            raise RuntimeError("Execution policy changed; operator verification is required")
        self.proxy = json.loads((self.fleet / "proxy.json").read_text())
        opener = urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.ProxyHandler({}))
        with opener.open(f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.proxy['port']}/__clanker_health", timeout=2) as response:
            health = json.load(response)
        if health != {"pid": self.proxy["pid"], "generation": self.proxy["generation"]}:
            raise RuntimeError("Web egress broker is unavailable")
        self.key = hashlib.sha256(str(self.home).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
        self.temp = Path("/private/tmp") / ("csx-" + self.key)
        self.browser = self.home / "browser" / "sandbox"
        self.bu_work = self.home / "cache" / "browser-use" / "workspace"
        self.terminal = self.home / "cache" / "terminal"
        for path in (self.temp, self.browser, self.bu_work, self.terminal,
                     self.home / "workspace", self.home / "artifacts", self.browser / "home"):
            if path.is_symlink() or path.resolve() != path:
                raise RuntimeError("Execution resource root was replaced")
            path.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    def lease(self, name):
        # Leases are never handed to another context during this broker generation.
        with (self.fleet / "leases.lock").open("a") as lock:
            fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
            path = self.fleet / "leases.json"
            leases = json.loads(path.read_text()) if path.exists() else {}
            key = str(self.home) + "\0" + name
            if key not in leases:
                used = {item["port"] for item in leases.values()} | {self.proxy["port"]}
                for port in range(46000, 59000):
                    if port in used:
                        continue
                    test = socket.socket()
                    try:
                        test.bind(("127.0.0.1", port))
                    except OSError:
                        test.close()
                        continue
                    test.close()
                    leases[key] = {"port": port, "home": str(self.home)}
                    atomic_json(path, leases)
                    break
                else:
                    raise RuntimeError("No browser-control ports are available")
            return leases[key]["port"]

    def owned_cdp(self, value):
        from urllib.parse import urlsplit
        parsed = urlsplit(value)
        if parsed.hostname not in {"127.0.0.1", "localhost", "::1"} or not parsed.port:
            raise RuntimeError("A context-owned local browser is required")
        leases = json.loads((self.fleet / "leases.json").read_text())
        if not any(item["port"] == parsed.port and item["home"] == str(self.home) for item in leases.values()):
            raise RuntimeError("Browser-control endpoint belongs to another context")
        return parsed.port

    def safe_env(self, *, name="default", cdp_url=None):
        env = {"HOME": str(self.browser / "home"), "HERMES_HOME": str(self.home),
               "PATH": f"{self.settings['hermes_venv']}/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin",
               "LANG": "en_US.UTF-8", "TMPDIR": str(self.temp), "TMP": str(self.temp),
               "MAC_CHROMIUM_TMPDIR": str(self.temp),
               "TEMP": str(self.temp), "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1",
               "ANONYMIZED_TELEMETRY": "false", "DO_NOT_TRACK": "1"}
        env.update(BH_TAB_MARKER='0', AGENT_BROWSER_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS='120000')
        tag = hashlib.sha256(name.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
        env.update(BU_NAME=name, BH_HOME=str(self.browser / "harness-home"),
                   BH_RUNTIME_DIR=str(self.temp / ("bu-" + tag)),
                   BH_TMP_DIR=str(self.browser / "harness" / tag),
                   BH_RUNTIME_DIR_SHARED="0", BH_TMP_DIR_SHARED="0",
                   BH_AGENT_WORKSPACE=str(self.bu_work / tag))
        proxy = f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.proxy['port']}"
        env.update(HTTP_PROXY=proxy, HTTPS_PROXY=proxy, ALL_PROXY=proxy,
                   http_proxy=proxy, https_proxy=proxy, NO_PROXY="localhost,127.0.0.1,::1")
        if cdp_url:
            self.owned_cdp(cdp_url)
            env["BU_CDP_WS" if cdp_url.startswith("ws") else "BU_CDP_URL"] = cdp_url
        return env

    def command(self, argv, *, cdp_port=None, chromium=False):
        if not Path("/usr/bin/sandbox-exec").is_file():
            raise RuntimeError("sandbox-exec is unavailable; execution is disabled")
        runtime = self.settings
        params = {
            "PYTHON": runtime["python"], "HERMES_VENV": runtime["hermes_venv"],
            "BU_VENV": runtime["bu_venv"], "BU_PYTHON": runtime["bu_python"],
            "NODE": runtime["node_runtime"], "AGENT_BROWSER": runtime["agent_browser_package"],
            "CHROMIUM": runtime["chromium_bundle"], "LAUNCHER": str(HERE),
            "WORK": str(self.home / "workspace"), "ARTIFACTS": str(self.home / "artifacts"),
            "BROWSER": str(self.browser), "BU_WORK": str(self.bu_work),
            "TERMINAL": str(self.terminal), "TEMP": str(self.temp),
            "PROXY": f"localhost:{self.proxy['port']}",
            "CDP": f"localhost:{cdp_port or self.proxy['port']}",
            "CHROME_MACH": "org.chromium.Chromium.MachPortRendezvousServer." + str(os.getpid()),
        }
        if chromium:
            extra = (HERE / 'chromium.sb').read_bytes()
            if hashlib.sha256(extra).hexdigest() != runtime['chromium_policy_sha256']:
                raise RuntimeError('Chromium execution policy changed')
            policy = (HERE / 'common.sb').read_text() + '\n' + extra.decode()
            command = ['/usr/bin/sandbox-exec', '-p', policy]
        else:
            command = ["/usr/bin/sandbox-exec", "-f", str(HERE / "common.sb")]
        for name, value in params.items():
            command.extend(["-D", name + "=" + value])
        return command + list(argv)

    def verify(self):
        protected = str(Path(self.settings["transport_home"]) / ".env")
        code = (
            "from pathlib import Path; import subprocess, sys, os\n"
            "p=Path('clanker-boundary-ready.tmp'); p.write_text('ready'); assert p.read_text()=='ready'; p.unlink()\n"
            f"try:\n Path({protected!r}).read_bytes()\nexcept PermissionError:\n pass\nelse:\n raise RuntimeError('protected read unexpectedly succeeded')\n"
            "assert not any(k in os.environ for k in ['SLACK_BOT_TOKEN','OPENAI_API_KEY','HERMES_API_KEY'])\n"
            "print('SEATBELT_READY')\n"
        )
        result = subprocess.run(self.command([self.settings["python_executable"], "-c", code]),
                                env=self.safe_env(), cwd=self.home / "workspace", close_fds=True,
                                capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15)
        if result.returncode or result.stdout.strip() != "SEATBELT_READY":
            raise RuntimeError("Execution readiness failed: " + result.stderr[-1000:])
        return True
"""Hermes plugin using the native terminal provider ABC and toolset resolver."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from seatbelt.context import Context
from agent.terminal_env_provider import TerminalEnvironmentProvider
from hermes_constants import get_hermes_home
from tools.environments.local import LocalEnvironment


def browser_tools():
    context=Context(get_hermes_home())
    config=Path(context.settings['transport_home'])/'.clanker-cloud/config.json'
    if config.exists() and json.loads(config.read_text()).get('enabled'):
        from cloud_browser.tools import TOOLS
        return [*TOOLS,'browser_exec']
    return ['browser_exec']


class SeatbeltEnvironment(LocalEnvironment):
    _sudo_nopasswd_probe_supported = False

    def __init__(self, *, cwd, timeout):
        self.execution = Context(get_hermes_home())
        base = self.execution.home / "workspace"
        path = Path(cwd).resolve() if cwd else base
        if not any(path.is_relative_to(root) for root in (base, self.execution.home / "artifacts")):
            raise RuntimeError("Terminal cwd is outside this context")
        super().__init__(cwd=str(path), timeout=timeout,
                         env={"TERMINAL_TEMP_DIR": str(self.execution.terminal)})

    def get_temp_dir(self):
        return str(self.execution.terminal)

    def _run_bash(self, cmd_string, *, login=False, timeout=120, stdin_data=None):
        context = Context(self.execution.home)
        env = context.safe_env()
        env["TERMINAL_TEMP_DIR"] = str(context.terminal)
        proc = subprocess.Popen(context.command(["/bin/bash", "-c", cmd_string]),
                                env=env, cwd=self.cwd, text=True, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace",
                                stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                                stdin=subprocess.PIPE if stdin_data is not None else subprocess.DEVNULL,
                                start_new_session=True, close_fds=True)
        if stdin_data is not None:
            from tools.environments.base_output import _pipe_stdin
            _pipe_stdin(proc, stdin_data)
        return proc


class SeatbeltProvider(TerminalEnvironmentProvider):
    name = "clanker_seatbelt"
    display_name = "Clanker macOS Seatbelt"
    is_remote = False
    is_container = False

    def is_available(self):
        try:
            Context(get_hermes_home())
            return True
        except Exception:
            return False

    def create_environment(self, *, cwd, timeout, **kwargs):
        return SeatbeltEnvironment(cwd=cwd, timeout=timeout)


def gate(tool_name, args, next_call, **kwargs):
    try:
        context = Context(get_hermes_home())
        from vault.tools import TOOLS as vault_tools
        if tool_name in vault_tools or tool_name in browser_tools() and tool_name!='browser_exec':
            return next_call(args)
        if tool_name not in {"browser_exec", "terminal"}:
            return json.dumps({"success": False, "error": "Tool is outside this context's browser policy"})
        allowed = ({'code', 'session', 'timeout_s'} if tool_name == 'browser_exec' else
                   {'command', 'timeout', 'background', 'workdir', 'pty', 'notify_on_complete', 'watch_patterns', 'heartbeat'})
        if set(args) - allowed:
            return json.dumps({'success': False, 'error': 'Unsupported execution arguments'})
        if not context.settings.get('activated'):
            return json.dumps({'success': False, 'error': 'Execution unavailable: operator acceptance is pending'})
        from agent.gateway_context import current_gateway_turn
        current = current_gateway_turn()
        if current is not None:
            from vault.service import binding
            turn = binding(current.task_id)
            turn.service.delegations.check_execution(turn)
        if tool_name == "terminal" and args.get("background"):
            return json.dumps({"success": False, "error": "Use foreground terminal calls in the current browser POC"})
        if tool_name == 'terminal' and args.get('pty'):
            return json.dumps({'success': False, 'error': 'PTY execution is unavailable in the current browser POC'})
        return next_call(args)
    except Exception as error:
        return json.dumps({"success": False, "error": "Execution unavailable: " + str(error)})


def register(ctx):
    from toolsets import create_custom_toolset
    from vault.tools import register_tools, TOOLS as vault_tools
    ctx.register_terminal_environment_provider(SeatbeltProvider())
    from vault.service import on_gateway_control
    ctx.register_hook('on_gateway_control', on_gateway_control)
    register_tools(ctx)
    selected=browser_tools()
    if selected!=['browser_exec']:
        from cloud_browser.tools import register_tools as register_cloud
        register_cloud(ctx)
    create_custom_toolset("clanker_browser", "Browser and private access", tools=[*selected, "terminal", *vault_tools])
    ctx.register_middleware("tool_execution", gate)
    ctx.register_system_prompt_section('clanker.payments',
        'For purchases, prepare the checkout in the private LOCAL browser using browser_exec, even when cloud browsing is configured. '
        'Local login/password and code tools use the local supervised browser when one is active. '
        'Use clanker_request_payment with the exact checkout_url, merchant, exact order summary, final amount_minor including fees, currency and an optional saved-card handle. '
        'The private form saves reusable card number/expiry and requests a temporary CVV plus explicit approval for this purchase. '
        'Invited card handles request that approval from the card owner, while the purchase resumes in the original requester\'s private task. '
        'Every purchase needs a fresh form, including use of a merchant-saved payment method. Never submit a payment with browser_exec, terminal or the cloud browser. '
        'End the turn after waiting_for_owner; the saved approval resumes it with a request_id for clanker_pay. '
        'Do not change the cart after approval. A changed checkout requires a new form. '
        'Do not send card details or CVV to Composio, a browser task prompt, Slack, local files or environment variables. '
        'After clanker_pay, verify the merchant receipt; submitted is not paid. An unknown result must be reconciled before a new payment. '
        'The current handler supports one-time top-level card checkout forms with one clear Pay/Place order button. '
        'If the checkout uses unsupported frames, a wallet, a subscription, or bank approval, stop and explain the required owner action.')
    ctx.register_system_prompt_section('clanker.api_keys',
        'For a user-supplied API key, check clanker_vault_list privately for saved access, then use '
        'clanker_request_access with kind api_key, a service-specific form title in label, and the exact HTTPS API origin. '
        'The title comes from the request; the template is shared across services. Do not open a browser login page for an API key. '
        'Never ask a Slack user to paste secrets, save a key in a local file, or configure an environment variable. '
        'After waiting_for_owner or moved_to_private, end the turn and wait for the hosted save to resume it. '
        'Use clanker_api_request with an owned or invited API-key handle and a relative API path to perform authorized API work. '
        'The backend supplies authentication on the saved exact HTTPS origin. Choose Authorization with Bearer, or the service\'s supported API-key header with an empty auth_scheme. '
        'Never supply or reveal the raw key. Invited handles grant use on the owner\'s behalf, not onward sharing. '
        'Use only the user-requested HTTP operation, and check uncertain outcomes before repeating work with side effects.')
    if selected!=['browser_exec']:
        ctx.register_system_prompt_section('clanker.browser',
            'Use clanker_browser_run for website tasks. Only the configured browser toolkit is available through Composio. '
            'Use consistent short session names and clanker_browser_status to wait for asynchronous work. '
            'A completed run is the browser agent\'s report; verify consequential website results. '
            'When a task finishes, use clanker_browser_stop to release the cloud browser. Keep it open only while waiting for a credential form. '
            'Browser routing is bound to the Slack workspace and authenticated requester. '
            'An existing website login is not permission to read an account: use only an owned or explicitly invited vault handle. '
            'A task-stop result does not prove remote cookies were deleted; respect cleanup-pending errors. '
            'When login is needed, stop the browser run at the login page. In a private DM, use clanker_vault_list '
            'and clanker_vault_fill for saved access; these launch a credential-fill run, so wait for its status before continuing. '
            'Use clanker_vault_enter_code for 2FA. The backend retrieves credentials; never put passwords or codes in browser task text. '
            'If saved access is missing or rejected, use clanker_request_access. The private hosted form resumes the task after saving. '
            'Shared-channel account tasks move to the requester\'s DM. After waiting_for_owner or moved_to_private, '
            'finish with a brief waiting status. Never invent access links or ask for credentials in Slack. '
            'Foreground terminal remains available for local workspace tasks. Use the cloud tool for ordinary browsing and browser_exec for approved-payment checkout preparation.')
        return
    ctx.register_system_prompt_section('clanker.browser',
        'Browser execution is available through browser_exec. Use it for website tasks without asking the user to activate a plugin. '
        'Use foreground terminal calls for other Python or shell work. Background and PTY execution are unavailable in this local POC. '
        'Only this conversation context\'s workspace and browser state are accessible. Channel contexts are shared by their members; DM contexts are private. '
        'When a website needs login, use clanker_vault_list in a private DM to find saved access. Type only the visible identifier, '
        'Use a consistent short browser session name for each website so its own saved session can be reused. '
        'then clanker_vault_fill to fill the password; use clanker_vault_enter_code for saved authenticator 2FA. '
        'When website cookies expire, sign in again using the saved vault handle. If credentials are missing or the saved password is rejected, '
        'call clanker_request_access while the actual login page is open. This sends a private hosted form '
        'and resumes the task after saving. In a shared channel this tool moves the account task and its results into the requester\'s DM. '

def _plugin_platform_bundle(name: str) -> List[str]:
    """Implicit `hermes-<platform>` bundle for a registered plugin platform: core
    tools plus whatever the plugin registered under the platform name. [] otherwise."""
    if not name.startswith("hermes-"):
        return []
    platform_name = name[len("hermes-"):]
    try:
        from gateway.platform_registry import platform_registry
        if not platform_registry.is_registered(platform_name):
            return []
    except Exception:
        return []

def resolve_toolset(name: str, visited: Set[str] = None, *, include_registry: bool = True) -> List[str]:
    """Recursively resolve a toolset (and its includes) to a sorted tool-name list.
    include_registry=False resolves the static TOOLSETS view only.

    Args: name (str): Name of the toolset to resolve visited (Set[str]): Set of already visited toolsets
    (for cycle detection) include_registry (bool): When True (default), include tools that plugins/overlays
    registered into a toolset. Platform reverse-mapping uses False so a registry-added tool cannot drop the
    whole toolset from inference (see #49622 and ``_get_platform_tools``).
    """
    external_call = visited is None
    if external_call:
        memo_key = (name, include_registry, *_registry_generation(), _registry_call("current_scope_key", ""))
        cached = _resolve_toolset_memo.get(memo_key)
        if cached is not None:
            return list(cached)
        visited = set()

    # "all"/"*" span every toolset so new toolsets are included automatically.
    if name in {"all", "*"}:
        all_tools: Set[str] = set()
        for toolset_name in get_toolset_names():
            all_tools.update(resolve_toolset(toolset_name, visited.copy(), include_registry=include_registry))
        return sorted(all_tools)

    # Diamond include or cycle: [] silently — the tools are collected via another path.
    if name in visited:
        return []
    visited.add(name)

    toolset = get_toolset(name, include_registry=include_registry)
    if not toolset:
        return _plugin_platform_bundle(name) if include_registry else []

    tools = set(toolset.get("tools", []))
    for included_name in toolset.get("includes", []):
        tools.update(resolve_toolset(included_name, visited, include_registry=include_registry))

    result = sorted(tools)
    if external_call:
        if len(_resolve_toolset_memo) >= 256:  # stale-generation entries are never hit again
            _resolve_toolset_memo.clear()
        _resolve_toolset_memo[memo_key] = list(result)
    return result

"""Trusted context policy construction, environment and port allocation."""
import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import socket
import subprocess
import urllib.request


HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def atomic_json(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    temporary = path.with_suffix(".tmp")
    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + "\n")
    temporary.chmod(0o600)
    os.replace(temporary, path)


class Context:
    def __init__(self, home):
        self.home = Path(home).resolve(strict=True)
        self.manifest = self.home / ".clanker-execution" / "context.json"
        self.config = json.loads(self.manifest.read_text())
        if self.config["home"] != str(self.home) or not self.config.get("enabled"):
            raise RuntimeError("No execution grant for this context")
        self.fleet = Path(self.config["fleet"])
        self.settings = json.loads((self.fleet / "fleet.json").read_text())
        if hashlib.sha256((HERE / "common.sb").read_bytes()).hexdigest() != self.settings["policy_sha256"]:
            raise RuntimeError("Execution policy changed; operator verification is required")
        self.proxy = json.loads((self.fleet / "proxy.json").read_text())
        opener = urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.ProxyHandler({}))
        with opener.open(f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.proxy['port']}/__clanker_health", timeout=2) as response:
            health = json.load(response)
        if health != {"pid": self.proxy["pid"], "generation": self.proxy["generation"]}:
            raise RuntimeError("Web egress broker is unavailable")
        self.key = hashlib.sha256(str(self.home).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
        self.temp = Path("/private/tmp") / ("csx-" + self.key)
        self.browser = self.home / "browser" / "sandbox"
        self.bu_work = self.home / "cache" / "browser-use" / "workspace"
        self.terminal = self.home / "cache" / "terminal"
        for path in (self.temp, self.browser, self.bu_work, self.terminal,
                     self.home / "workspace", self.home / "artifacts", self.browser / "home"):
            if path.is_symlink() or path.resolve() != path:
                raise RuntimeError("Execution resource root was replaced")
            path.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    def lease(self, name):
        # Leases are never handed to another context during this broker generation.
        with (self.fleet / "leases.lock").open("a") as lock:
            fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
            path = self.fleet / "leases.json"
            leases = json.loads(path.read_text()) if path.exists() else {}
            key = str(self.home) + "\0" + name
            if key not in leases:
                used = {item["port"] for item in leases.values()} | {self.proxy["port"]}
                for port in range(46000, 59000):
                    if port in used:
                        continue
                    test = socket.socket()
                    try:
                        test.bind(("127.0.0.1", port))
                    except OSError:
                        test.close()
                        continue
                    test.close()
                    leases[key] = {"port": port, "home": str(self.home)}
                    atomic_json(path, leases)
                    break
                else:
                    raise RuntimeError("No browser-control ports are available")
            return leases[key]["port"]

    def owned_cdp(self, value):
        from urllib.parse import urlsplit
        parsed = urlsplit(value)
        if parsed.hostname not in {"127.0.0.1", "localhost", "::1"} or not parsed.port:
            raise RuntimeError("A context-owned local browser is required")
        leases = json.loads((self.fleet / "leases.json").read_text())
        if not any(item["port"] == parsed.port and item["home"] == str(self.home) for item in leases.values()):
            raise RuntimeError("Browser-control endpoint belongs to another context")
        return parsed.port

    def safe_env(self, *, name="default", cdp_url=None):
        env = {"HOME": str(self.browser / "home"), "HERMES_HOME": str(self.home),
               "PATH": f"{self.settings['hermes_venv']}/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin",
               "LANG": "en_US.UTF-8", "TMPDIR": str(self.temp), "TMP": str(self.temp),
               "MAC_CHROMIUM_TMPDIR": str(self.temp),
               "TEMP": str(self.temp), "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1",
               "ANONYMIZED_TELEMETRY": "false", "DO_NOT_TRACK": "1"}
        env.update(BH_TAB_MARKER='0', AGENT_BROWSER_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS='120000')
        tag = hashlib.sha256(name.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
        env.update(BU_NAME=name, BH_HOME=str(self.browser / "harness-home"),
                   BH_RUNTIME_DIR=str(self.temp / ("bu-" + tag)),
                   BH_TMP_DIR=str(self.browser / "harness" / tag),
                   BH_RUNTIME_DIR_SHARED="0", BH_TMP_DIR_SHARED="0",
                   BH_AGENT_WORKSPACE=str(self.bu_work / tag))
        proxy = f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.proxy['port']}"
        env.update(HTTP_PROXY=proxy, HTTPS_PROXY=proxy, ALL_PROXY=proxy,
                   http_proxy=proxy, https_proxy=proxy, NO_PROXY="localhost,127.0.0.1,::1")
        if cdp_url:
            self.owned_cdp(cdp_url)
            env["BU_CDP_WS" if cdp_url.startswith("ws") else "BU_CDP_URL"] = cdp_url
        return env

    def command(self, argv, *, cdp_port=None, chromium=False):
        if not Path("/usr/bin/sandbox-exec").is_file():
            raise RuntimeError("sandbox-exec is unavailable; execution is disabled")
        runtime = self.settings
        params = {
            "PYTHON": runtime["python"], "HERMES_VENV": runtime["hermes_venv"],
            "BU_VENV": runtime["bu_venv"], "BU_PYTHON": runtime["bu_python"],
            "NODE": runtime["node_runtime"], "AGENT_BROWSER": runtime["agent_browser_package"],
            "CHROMIUM": runtime["chromium_bundle"], "LAUNCHER": str(HERE),
            "WORK": str(self.home / "workspace"), "ARTIFACTS": str(self.home / "artifacts"),
            "BROWSER": str(self.browser), "BU_WORK": str(self.bu_work),
            "TERMINAL": str(self.terminal), "TEMP": str(self.temp),
            "PROXY": f"localhost:{self.proxy['port']}",
            "CDP": f"localhost:{cdp_port or self.proxy['port']}",
            "CHROME_MACH": "org.chromium.Chromium.MachPortRendezvousServer." + str(os.getpid()),
        }
        if chromium:
            extra = (HERE / 'chromium.sb').read_bytes()
            if hashlib.sha256(extra).hexdigest() != runtime['chromium_policy_sha256']:
                raise RuntimeError('Chromium execution policy changed')
            policy = (HERE / 'common.sb').read_text() + '\n' + extra.decode()
            command = ['/usr/bin/sandbox-exec', '-p', policy]
        else:
            command = ["/usr/bin/sandbox-exec", "-f", str(HERE / "common.sb")]
        for name, value in params.items():
            command.extend(["-D", name + "=" + value])
        return command + list(argv)

    def verify(self):
        protected = str(Path(self.settings["transport_home"]) / ".env")
        code = (
            "from pathlib import Path; import subprocess, sys, os\n"
            "p=Path('clanker-boundary-ready.tmp'); p.write_text('ready'); assert p.read_text()=='ready'; p.unlink()\n"
            f"try:\n Path({protected!r}).read_bytes()\nexcept PermissionError:\n pass\nelse:\n raise RuntimeError('protected read unexpectedly succeeded')\n"
            "assert not any(k in os.environ for k in ['SLACK_BOT_TOKEN','OPENAI_API_KEY','HERMES_API_KEY'])\n"
            "print('SEATBELT_READY')\n"
        )
        result = subprocess.run(self.command([self.settings["python_executable"], "-c", code]),
                                env=self.safe_env(), cwd=self.home / "workspace", close_fds=True,
                                capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15)
        if result.returncode or result.stdout.strip() != "SEATBELT_READY":
            raise RuntimeError("Execution readiness failed: " + result.stderr[-1000:])
        return True

def gate(tool_name, args, next_call, **kwargs):
    try:
        context = Context(get_hermes_home())
        from vault.tools import TOOLS as vault_tools
        if tool_name in vault_tools or tool_name in browser_tools() and tool_name!='browser_exec':
            return next_call(args)
        if tool_name not in {"browser_exec", "terminal"}:
            return json.dumps({"success": False, "error": "Tool is outside this context's browser policy"})
        allowed = ({'code', 'session', 'timeout_s'} if tool_name == 'browser_exec' else
                   {'command', 'timeout', 'background', 'workdir', 'pty', 'notify_on_complete', 'watch_patterns', 'heartbeat'})
        if set(args) - allowed:
            return json.dumps({'success': False, 'error': 'Unsupported execution arguments'})
        if not context.settings.get('activated'):
            return json.dumps({'success': False, 'error': 'Execution unavailable: operator acceptance is pending'})
        from agent.gateway_context import current_gateway_turn
        current = current_gateway_turn()
        if current is not None:
            from vault.service import binding
            turn = binding(current.task_id)
            turn.service.delegations.check_execution(turn)
        if tool_name == "terminal" and args.get("background"):
            return json.dumps({"success": False, "error": "Use foreground terminal calls in the current browser POC"})
        if tool_name == 'terminal' and args.get('pty'):
            return json.dumps({'success': False, 'error': 'PTY execution is unavailable in the current browser POC'})
        return next_call(args)
    except Exception as error:
        return json.dumps({"success": False, "error": "Execution unavailable: " + str(error)})

def _plugin_platform_bundle(name: str) -> List[str]:
    """Implicit `hermes-<platform>` bundle for a registered plugin platform: core
    tools plus whatever the plugin registered under the platform name. [] otherwise."""
    if not name.startswith("hermes-"):
        return []
    platform_name = name[len("hermes-"):]
    try:
        from gateway.platform_registry import platform_registry
        if not platform_registry.is_registered(platform_name):
            return []
    except Exception:
        return []
    tools = set(_HERMES_CORE_TOOLS)
    try:
        tools.update(e.name for e in _registry_call("get_all_entries", ()) if e.toolset == platform_name)
    except Exception:
        pass
    return list(tools)


def resolve_toolset(name: str, visited: Set[str] = None, *, include_registry: bool = True) -> List[str]:
    """Recursively resolve a toolset (and its includes) to a sorted tool-name list.
    include_registry=False resolves the static TOOLSETS view only.

    Args: name (str): Name of the toolset to resolve visited (Set[str]): Set of already visited toolsets
    (for cycle detection) include_registry (bool): When True (default), include tools that plugins/overlays
    registered into a toolset. Platform reverse-mapping uses False so a registry-added tool cannot drop the
    whole toolset from inference (see #49622 and ``_get_platform_tools``).
    """
    external_call = visited is None
    if external_call:
        memo_key = (name, include_registry, *_registry_generation(), _registry_call("current_scope_key", ""))
        cached = _resolve_toolset_memo.get(memo_key)
        if cached is not None:
            return list(cached)
        visited = set()

    # "all"/"*" span every toolset so new toolsets are included automatically.
    if name in {"all", "*"}:
        all_tools: Set[str] = set()
        for toolset_name in get_toolset_names():
            all_tools.update(resolve_toolset(toolset_name, visited.copy(), include_registry=include_registry))
        return sorted(all_tools)

    # Diamond include or cycle: [] silently — the tools are collected via another path.
    if name in visited:
        return []
    visited.add(name)

    toolset = get_toolset(name, include_registry=include_registry)
    if not toolset:
        return _plugin_platform_bundle(name) if include_registry else []

    tools = set(toolset.get("tools", []))
    for included_name in toolset.get("includes", []):
        tools.update(resolve_toolset(included_name, visited, include_registry=include_registry))

    result = sorted(tools)
    if external_call:
        if len(_resolve_toolset_memo) >= 256:  # stale-generation entries are never hit again
            _resolve_toolset_memo.clear()
        _resolve_toolset_memo[memo_key] = list(result)
    return result

"""Trusted context policy construction, environment and port allocation."""
import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import socket
import subprocess
import urllib.request


HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def atomic_json(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    temporary = path.with_suffix(".tmp")
    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + "\n")
    temporary.chmod(0o600)
    os.replace(temporary, path)


class Context:
    def __init__(self, home):
        self.home = Path(home).resolve(strict=True)
        self.manifest = self.home / ".clanker-execution" / "context.json"
        self.config = json.loads(self.manifest.read_text())
        if self.config["home"] != str(self.home) or not self.config.get("enabled"):
            raise RuntimeError("No execution grant for this context")
        self.fleet = Path(self.config["fleet"])
        self.settings = json.loads((self.fleet / "fleet.json").read_text())
        if hashlib.sha256((HERE / "common.sb").read_bytes()).hexdigest() != self.settings["policy_sha256"]:
            raise RuntimeError("Execution policy changed; operator verification is required")
        self.proxy = json.loads((self.fleet / "proxy.json").read_text())
        opener = urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.ProxyHandler({}))
        with opener.open(f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.proxy['port']}/__clanker_health", timeout=2) as response:
            health = json.load(response)
        if health != {"pid": self.proxy["pid"], "generation": self.proxy["generation"]}:
            raise RuntimeError("Web egress broker is unavailable")
        self.key = hashlib.sha256(str(self.home).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
        self.temp = Path("/private/tmp") / ("csx-" + self.key)
        self.browser = self.home / "browser" / "sandbox"
        self.bu_work = self.home / "cache" / "browser-use" / "workspace"
        self.terminal = self.home / "cache" / "terminal"
        for path in (self.temp, self.browser, self.bu_work, self.terminal,
                     self.home / "workspace", self.home / "artifacts", self.browser / "home"):
            if path.is_symlink() or path.resolve() != path:
                raise RuntimeError("Execution resource root was replaced")
            path.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    def lease(self, name):
        # Leases are never handed to another context during this broker generation.
        with (self.fleet / "leases.lock").open("a") as lock:
            fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
            path = self.fleet / "leases.json"
            leases = json.loads(path.read_text()) if path.exists() else {}
            key = str(self.home) + "\0" + name
            if key not in leases:
                used = {item["port"] for item in leases.values()} | {self.proxy["port"]}
                for port in range(46000, 59000):
                    if port in used:
                        continue
                    test = socket.socket()
                    try:
                        test.bind(("127.0.0.1", port))
                    except OSError:
                        test.close()
                        continue
                    test.close()
                    leases[key] = {"port": port, "home": str(self.home)}
                    atomic_json(path, leases)
                    break
                else:
                    raise RuntimeError("No browser-control ports are available")
            return leases[key]["port"]

    def owned_cdp(self, value):
        from urllib.parse import urlsplit
        parsed = urlsplit(value)
        if parsed.hostname not in {"127.0.0.1", "localhost", "::1"} or not parsed.port:
            raise RuntimeError("A context-owned local browser is required")
        leases = json.loads((self.fleet / "leases.json").read_text())
        if not any(item["port"] == parsed.port and item["home"] == str(self.home) for item in leases.values()):
            raise RuntimeError("Browser-control endpoint belongs to another context")
        return parsed.port

    def safe_env(self, *, name="default", cdp_url=None):
        env = {"HOME": str(self.browser / "home"), "HERMES_HOME": str(self.home),
               "PATH": f"{self.settings['hermes_venv']}/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin",
               "LANG": "en_US.UTF-8", "TMPDIR": str(self.temp), "TMP": str(self.temp),
               "MAC_CHROMIUM_TMPDIR": str(self.temp),
               "TEMP": str(self.temp), "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1",
               "ANONYMIZED_TELEMETRY": "false", "DO_NOT_TRACK": "1"}
        env.update(BH_TAB_MARKER='0', AGENT_BROWSER_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS='120000')
        tag = hashlib.sha256(name.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
        env.update(BU_NAME=name, BH_HOME=str(self.browser / "harness-home"),
                   BH_RUNTIME_DIR=str(self.temp / ("bu-" + tag)),
                   BH_TMP_DIR=str(self.browser / "harness" / tag),
                   BH_RUNTIME_DIR_SHARED="0", BH_TMP_DIR_SHARED="0",
                   BH_AGENT_WORKSPACE=str(self.bu_work / tag))
        proxy = f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.proxy['port']}"
        env.update(HTTP_PROXY=proxy, HTTPS_PROXY=proxy, ALL_PROXY=proxy,
                   http_proxy=proxy, https_proxy=proxy, NO_PROXY="localhost,127.0.0.1,::1")
        if cdp_url:
            self.owned_cdp(cdp_url)
            env["BU_CDP_WS" if cdp_url.startswith("ws") else "BU_CDP_URL"] = cdp_url
        return env

    def command(self, argv, *, cdp_port=None, chromium=False):
        if not Path("/usr/bin/sandbox-exec").is_file():
            raise RuntimeError("sandbox-exec is unavailable; execution is disabled")
        runtime = self.settings
        params = {
            "PYTHON": runtime["python"], "HERMES_VENV": runtime["hermes_venv"],
            "BU_VENV": runtime["bu_venv"], "BU_PYTHON": runtime["bu_python"],
            "NODE": runtime["node_runtime"], "AGENT_BROWSER": runtime["agent_browser_package"],
            "CHROMIUM": runtime["chromium_bundle"], "LAUNCHER": str(HERE),
            "WORK": str(self.home / "workspace"), "ARTIFACTS": str(self.home / "artifacts"),
            "BROWSER": str(self.browser), "BU_WORK": str(self.bu_work),
            "TERMINAL": str(self.terminal), "TEMP": str(self.temp),
            "PROXY": f"localhost:{self.proxy['port']}",
            "CDP": f"localhost:{cdp_port or self.proxy['port']}",
            "CHROME_MACH": "org.chromium.Chromium.MachPortRendezvousServer." + str(os.getpid()),
        }
        if chromium:
            extra = (HERE / 'chromium.sb').read_bytes()
            if hashlib.sha256(extra).hexdigest() != runtime['chromium_policy_sha256']:
                raise RuntimeError('Chromium execution policy changed')
            policy = (HERE / 'common.sb').read_text() + '\n' + extra.decode()
            command = ['/usr/bin/sandbox-exec', '-p', policy]
        else:
            command = ["/usr/bin/sandbox-exec", "-f", str(HERE / "common.sb")]
        for name, value in params.items():
            command.extend(["-D", name + "=" + value])
        return command + list(argv)

    def verify(self):
        protected = str(Path(self.settings["transport_home"]) / ".env")
        code = (
            "from pathlib import Path; import subprocess, sys, os\n"
            "p=Path('clanker-boundary-ready.tmp'); p.write_text('ready'); assert p.read_text()=='ready'; p.unlink()\n"
            f"try:\n Path({protected!r}).read_bytes()\nexcept PermissionError:\n pass\nelse:\n raise RuntimeError('protected read unexpectedly succeeded')\n"
            "assert not any(k in os.environ for k in ['SLACK_BOT_TOKEN','OPENAI_API_KEY','HERMES_API_KEY'])\n"
            "print('SEATBELT_READY')\n"
        )
        result = subprocess.run(self.command([self.settings["python_executable"], "-c", code]),
                                env=self.safe_env(), cwd=self.home / "workspace", close_fds=True,
                                capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15)
        if result.returncode or result.stdout.strip() != "SEATBELT_READY":
            raise RuntimeError("Execution readiness failed: " + result.stderr[-1000:])
        return True

def browser_tools():

    if config.exists() and json.loads(config.read_text()).get('enabled'):

class SeatbeltEnvironment(LocalEnvironment):
    _sudo_nopasswd_probe_supported = False

    def __init__(self, *, cwd, timeout):
        self.execution = Context(get_hermes_home())
        base = self.execution.home / "workspace"
        path = Path(cwd).resolve() if cwd else base
        if not any(path.is_relative_to(root) for root in (base, self.execution.home / "artifacts")):
            raise RuntimeError("Terminal cwd is outside this context")
        super().__init__(cwd=str(path), timeout=timeout,
                         env={"TERMINAL_TEMP_DIR": str(self.execution.terminal)})

    def get_temp_dir(self):
        return str(self.execution.terminal)

    def _run_bash(self, cmd_string, *, login=False, timeout=120, stdin_data=None):
        context = Context(self.execution.home)
        env = context.safe_env()
        env["TERMINAL_TEMP_DIR"] = str(context.terminal)
        proc = subprocess.Popen(context.command(["/bin/bash", "-c", cmd_string]),
                                env=env, cwd=self.cwd, text=True, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace",
                                stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                                stdin=subprocess.PIPE if stdin_data is not None else subprocess.DEVNULL,
                                start_new_session=True, close_fds=True)

def gate(tool_name, args, next_call, **kwargs):
    try:
        context = Context(get_hermes_home())
        from vault.tools import TOOLS as vault_tools
        if tool_name in vault_tools or tool_name in browser_tools() and tool_name!='browser_exec':
            return next_call(args)
        if tool_name not in {"browser_exec", "terminal"}:
            return json.dumps({"success": False, "error": "Tool is outside this context's browser policy"})
        allowed = ({'code', 'session', 'timeout_s'} if tool_name == 'browser_exec' else
                   {'command', 'timeout', 'background', 'workdir', 'pty', 'notify_on_complete', 'watch_patterns', 'heartbeat'})
        if set(args) - allowed:
            return json.dumps({'success': False, 'error': 'Unsupported execution arguments'})
        if not context.settings.get('activated'):
            return json.dumps({'success': False, 'error': 'Execution unavailable: operator acceptance is pending'})
        from agent.gateway_context import current_gateway_turn
        current = current_gateway_turn()
        if current is not None:
            from vault.service import binding
            turn = binding(current.task_id)
            turn.service.delegations.check_execution(turn)
        if tool_name == "terminal" and args.get("background"):
            return json.dumps({"success": False, "error": "Use foreground terminal calls in the current browser POC"})
        if tool_name == 'terminal' and args.get('pty'):
            return json.dumps({'success': False, 'error': 'PTY execution is unavailable in the current browser POC'})
        return next_call(args)
    except Exception as error:
        return json.dumps({"success": False, "error": "Execution unavailable: " + str(error)})

def _plugin_platform_bundle(name: str) -> List[str]:
    """Implicit `hermes-<platform>` bundle for a registered plugin platform: core
    tools plus whatever the plugin registered under the platform name. [] otherwise."""
    if not name.startswith("hermes-"):

    try:

        if not platform_registry.is_registered(platform_name):

def resolve_toolset(name: str, visited: Set[str] = None, *, include_registry: bool = True) -> List[str]:
    """Recursively resolve a toolset (and its includes) to a sorted tool-name list.
    include_registry=False resolves the static TOOLSETS view only.

    Args: name (str): Name of the toolset to resolve visited (Set[str]): Set of already visited toolsets
    (for cycle detection) include_registry (bool): When True (default), include tools that plugins/overlays
    registered into a toolset. Platform reverse-mapping uses False so a registry-added tool cannot drop the
    whole toolset from inference (see #49622 and ``_get_platform_tools``).
    """
    external_call = visited is None
    if external_call:
        memo_key = (name, include_registry, *_registry_generation(), _registry_call("current_scope_key", ""))
        cached = _resolve_toolset_memo.get(memo_key)
        if cached is not None:
            return list(cached)
        visited = set()

    # "all"/"*" span every toolset so new toolsets are included automatically.
    if name in {"all", "*"}:
        all_tools: Set[str] = set()
        for toolset_name in get_toolset_names():
            all_tools.update(resolve_toolset(toolset_name, visited.copy(), include_registry=include_registry))
        return sorted(all_tools)

    # Diamond include or cycle: [] silently — the tools are collected via another path.
    if name in visited:
        return []
    visited.add(name)

    toolset = get_toolset(name, include_registry=include_registry)
    if not toolset:
        return _plugin_platform_bundle(name) if include_registry else []

    tools = set(toolset.get("tools", []))
    for included_name in toolset.get("includes", []):
        tools.update(resolve_toolset(included_name, visited, include_registry=include_registry))

    result = sorted(tools)
    if external_call:
        if len(_resolve_toolset_memo) >= 256:  # stale-generation entries are never hit again
            _resolve_toolset_memo.clear()
        _resolve_toolset_memo[memo_key] = list(result)
    return result

"""Trusted context policy construction, environment and port allocation."""
import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import socket
import subprocess
import urllib.request


HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def atomic_json(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    temporary = path.with_suffix(".tmp")
    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + "\n")
    temporary.chmod(0o600)
    os.replace(temporary, path)


class Context:
    def __init__(self, home):
        self.home = Path(home).resolve(strict=True)
        self.manifest = self.home / ".clanker-execution" / "context.json"
        self.config = json.loads(self.manifest.read_text())
        if self.config["home"] != str(self.home) or not self.config.get("enabled"):
            raise RuntimeError("No execution grant for this context")
        self.fleet = Path(self.config["fleet"])
        self.settings = json.loads((self.fleet / "fleet.json").read_text())
        if hashlib.sha256((HERE / "common.sb").read_bytes()).hexdigest() != self.settings["policy_sha256"]:
            raise RuntimeError("Execution policy changed; operator verification is required")
        self.proxy = json.loads((self.fleet / "proxy.json").read_text())
        opener = urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.ProxyHandler({}))
        with opener.open(f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.proxy['port']}/__clanker_health", timeout=2) as response:
            health = json.load(response)
        if health != {"pid": self.proxy["pid"], "generation": self.proxy["generation"]}:
            raise RuntimeError("Web egress broker is unavailable")
        self.key = hashlib.sha256(str(self.home).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
        self.temp = Path("/private/tmp") / ("csx-" + self.key)
        self.browser = self.home / "browser" / "sandbox"
        self.bu_work = self.home / "cache" / "browser-use" / "workspace"
        self.terminal = self.home / "cache" / "terminal"
        for path in (self.temp, self.browser, self.bu_work, self.terminal,
                     self.home / "workspace", self.home / "artifacts", self.browser / "home"):
            if path.is_symlink() or path.resolve() != path:
                raise RuntimeError("Execution resource root was replaced")
            path.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    def lease(self, name):
        # Leases are never handed to another context during this broker generation.
        with (self.fleet / "leases.lock").open("a") as lock:
            fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
            path = self.fleet / "leases.json"
            leases = json.loads(path.read_text()) if path.exists() else {}
            key = str(self.home) + "\0" + name
            if key not in leases:
                used = {item["port"] for item in leases.values()} | {self.proxy["port"]}
                for port in range(46000, 59000):
                    if port in used:
                        continue
                    test = socket.socket()
                    try:
                        test.bind(("127.0.0.1", port))
                    except OSError:
                        test.close()
                        continue
                    test.close()
                    leases[key] = {"port": port, "home": str(self.home)}
                    atomic_json(path, leases)
                    break
                else:
                    raise RuntimeError("No browser-control ports are available")
            return leases[key]["port"]

    def owned_cdp(self, value):
        from urllib.parse import urlsplit
        parsed = urlsplit(value)
        if parsed.hostname not in {"127.0.0.1", "localhost", "::1"} or not parsed.port:
            raise RuntimeError("A context-owned local browser is required")
        leases = json.loads((self.fleet / "leases.json").read_text())
        if not any(item["port"] == parsed.port and item["home"] == str(self.home) for item in leases.values()):
            raise RuntimeError("Browser-control endpoint belongs to another context")
        return parsed.port

    def safe_env(self, *, name="default", cdp_url=None):
        env = {"HOME": str(self.browser / "home"), "HERMES_HOME": str(self.home),
               "PATH": f"{self.settings['hermes_venv']}/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin",
               "LANG": "en_US.UTF-8", "TMPDIR": str(self.temp), "TMP": str(self.temp),
               "MAC_CHROMIUM_TMPDIR": str(self.temp),
               "TEMP": str(self.temp), "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1",
               "ANONYMIZED_TELEMETRY": "false", "DO_NOT_TRACK": "1"}
        env.update(BH_TAB_MARKER='0', AGENT_BROWSER_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS='120000')
        tag = hashlib.sha256(name.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
        env.update(BU_NAME=name, BH_HOME=str(self.browser / "harness-home"),
                   BH_RUNTIME_DIR=str(self.temp / ("bu-" + tag)),
                   BH_TMP_DIR=str(self.browser / "harness" / tag),
                   BH_RUNTIME_DIR_SHARED="0", BH_TMP_DIR_SHARED="0",
                   BH_AGENT_WORKSPACE=str(self.bu_work / tag))
        proxy = f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.proxy['port']}"
        env.update(HTTP_PROXY=proxy, HTTPS_PROXY=proxy, ALL_PROXY=proxy,
                   http_proxy=proxy, https_proxy=proxy, NO_PROXY="localhost,127.0.0.1,::1")
        if cdp_url:
            self.owned_cdp(cdp_url)
            env["BU_CDP_WS" if cdp_url.startswith("ws") else "BU_CDP_URL"] = cdp_url
        return env

    def command(self, argv, *, cdp_port=None, chromium=False):
        if not Path("/usr/bin/sandbox-exec").is_file():
            raise RuntimeError("sandbox-exec is unavailable; execution is disabled")
        runtime = self.settings
        params = {
            "PYTHON": runtime["python"], "HERMES_VENV": runtime["hermes_venv"],
            "BU_VENV": runtime["bu_venv"], "BU_PYTHON": runtime["bu_python"],
            "NODE": runtime["node_runtime"], "AGENT_BROWSER": runtime["agent_browser_package"],
            "CHROMIUM": runtime["chromium_bundle"], "LAUNCHER": str(HERE),
            "WORK": str(self.home / "workspace"), "ARTIFACTS": str(self.home / "artifacts"),
            "BROWSER": str(self.browser), "BU_WORK": str(self.bu_work),
            "TERMINAL": str(self.terminal), "TEMP": str(self.temp),
            "PROXY": f"localhost:{self.proxy['port']}",
            "CDP": f"localhost:{cdp_port or self.proxy['port']}",
            "CHROME_MACH": "org.chromium.Chromium.MachPortRendezvousServer." + str(os.getpid()),
        }
        if chromium:
            extra = (HERE / 'chromium.sb').read_bytes()
            if hashlib.sha256(extra).hexdigest() != runtime['chromium_policy_sha256']:
                raise RuntimeError('Chromium execution policy changed')
            policy = (HERE / 'common.sb').read_text() + '\n' + extra.decode()
            command = ['/usr/bin/sandbox-exec', '-p', policy]
        else:
            command = ["/usr/bin/sandbox-exec", "-f", str(HERE / "common.sb")]
        for name, value in params.items():
            command.extend(["-D", name + "=" + value])
        return command + list(argv)

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

def browser_tools():
    context=Context(get_hermes_home())
    config=Path(context.settings['transport_home'])/'.clanker-cloud/config.json'
    if config.exists() and json.loads(config.read_text()).get('enabled'):
        from cloud_browser.tools import TOOLS
        return [*TOOLS,'browser_exec']
    return ['browser_exec']


class SeatbeltEnvironment(LocalEnvironment):
    _sudo_nopasswd_probe_supported = False

    def __init__(self, *, cwd, timeout):
        self.execution = Context(get_hermes_home())
        base = self.execution.home / "workspace"
        path = Path(cwd).resolve() if cwd else base
        if not any(path.is_relative_to(root) for root in (base, self.execution.home / "artifacts")):
            raise RuntimeError("Terminal cwd is outside this context")
        super().__init__(cwd=str(path), timeout=timeout,
                         env={"TERMINAL_TEMP_DIR": str(self.execution.terminal)})

    def get_temp_dir(self):
        return str(self.execution.terminal)

    def _run_bash(self, cmd_string, *, login=False, timeout=120, stdin_data=None):
        context = Context(self.execution.home)
        env = context.safe_env()
        env["TERMINAL_TEMP_DIR"] = str(context.terminal)
        proc = subprocess.Popen(context.command(["/bin/bash", "-c", cmd_string]),
                                env=env, cwd=self.cwd, text=True, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace",
                                stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                                stdin=subprocess.PIPE if stdin_data is not None else subprocess.DEVNULL,
                                start_new_session=True, close_fds=True)
        if stdin_data is not None:
            from tools.environments.base_output import _pipe_stdin
            _pipe_stdin(proc, stdin_data)
        return proc


class SeatbeltProvider(TerminalEnvironmentProvider):
    name = "clanker_seatbelt"
    display_name = "Clanker macOS Seatbelt"
    is_remote = False
    is_container = False

    def is_available(self):
        try:
            Context(get_hermes_home())
            return True
        except Exception:
            return False

    def create_environment(self, *, cwd, timeout, **kwargs):
        return SeatbeltEnvironment(cwd=cwd, timeout=timeout)


def gate(tool_name, args, next_call, **kwargs):
    try:
        context = Context(get_hermes_home())
        from vault.tools import TOOLS as vault_tools
        if tool_name in vault_tools or tool_name in browser_tools() and tool_name!='browser_exec':
            return next_call(args)
        if tool_name not in {"browser_exec", "terminal"}:
            return json.dumps({"success": False, "error": "Tool is outside this context's browser policy"})
        allowed = ({'code', 'session', 'timeout_s'} if tool_name == 'browser_exec' else
                   {'command', 'timeout', 'background', 'workdir', 'pty', 'notify_on_complete', 'watch_patterns', 'heartbeat'})
        if set(args) - allowed:
            return json.dumps({'success': False, 'error': 'Unsupported execution arguments'})
        if not context.settings.get('activated'):
            return json.dumps({'success': False, 'error': 'Execution unavailable: operator acceptance is pending'})
        from agent.gateway_context import current_gateway_turn
        current = current_gateway_turn()
        if current is not None:
            from vault.service import binding
            turn = binding(current.task_id)
            turn.service.delegations.check_execution(turn)
        if tool_name == "terminal" and args.get("background"):
            return json.dumps({"success": False, "error": "Use foreground terminal calls in the current browser POC"})
        if tool_name == 'terminal' and args.get('pty'):
            return json.dumps({'success': False, 'error': 'PTY execution is unavailable in the current browser POC'})
        return next_call(args)
    except Exception as error:
        return json.dumps({"success": False, "error": "Execution unavailable: " + str(error)})

def _plugin_platform_bundle(name: str) -> List[str]:
    """Implicit `hermes-<platform>` bundle for a registered plugin platform: core
    tools plus whatever the plugin registered under the platform name. [] otherwise."""
    if not name.startswith("hermes-"):

    platform_name = name[len("hermes-"):]
    try:
        from gateway.platform_registry import platform_registry
        if not platform_registry.is_registered(platform_name):

def resolve_toolset(name: str, visited: Set[str] = None, *, include_registry: bool = True) -> List[str]:
    """Recursively resolve a toolset (and its includes) to a sorted tool-name list.
    include_registry=False resolves the static TOOLSETS view only.

    Args: name (str): Name of the toolset to resolve visited (Set[str]): Set of already visited toolsets
    (for cycle detection) include_registry (bool): When True (default), include tools that plugins/overlays
    registered into a toolset. Platform reverse-mapping uses False so a registry-added tool cannot drop the
    whole toolset from inference (see #49622 and ``_get_platform_tools``).
    """
    external_call = visited is None
    if external_call:
        memo_key = (name, include_registry, *_registry_generation(), _registry_call("current_scope_key", ""))
        cached = _resolve_toolset_memo.get(memo_key)
        if cached is not None:
            return list(cached)
        visited = set()

    # "all"/"*" span every toolset so new toolsets are included automatically.
    if name in {"all", "*"}:
        all_tools: Set[str] = set()
        for toolset_name in get_toolset_names():
            all_tools.update(resolve_toolset(toolset_name, visited.copy(), include_registry=include_registry))
        return sorted(all_tools)

    # Diamond include or cycle: [] silently — the tools are collected via another path.
    if name in visited:
        return []
    visited.add(name)

    toolset = get_toolset(name, include_registry=include_registry)
    if not toolset:
        return _plugin_platform_bundle(name) if include_registry else []

    tools = set(toolset.get("tools", []))
    for included_name in toolset.get("includes", []):
        tools.update(resolve_toolset(included_name, visited, include_registry=include_registry))

    result = sorted(tools)
    if external_call:
        if len(_resolve_toolset_memo) >= 256:  # stale-generation entries are never hit again
            _resolve_toolset_memo.clear()
        _resolve_toolset_memo[memo_key] = list(result)
    return result
